citation.title: Food Impaction in Dentistry: Revisited
citation.authors: Truong VM, Kim S, Yi YJ, Park YS

s_design.anchor: review with a documented single-database search, screening flow and inclusion criteria, no risk-of-bias appraisal and no meta-analysis (ETIOLOGY SR/MA row, 100; its methodological weakness is priced by AMSTAR-2 in Step 3, not by the anchor)
s_design.evidence_quote: The PubMed database was searched for this review.

domains.note: absent: read Abstract, Materials and Methods (database → search terms → timespan → screening → inclusion criteria), Results and Acknowledgement; no protocol, registration, PROSPERO or a-priori design wording anywhere in the text

domains.evidence_quote: Materials and Methods: A search was conducted in PubMed from 1947 to March 28, 2023.
domains.note: present but fails the 3b-i threshold: 1 bibliographic database searched (PubMed only), fewer than 2

domains.evidence_quote: yielded a total of 1293 studies. After screening the title, abstract,
domains.note: no list of individually identified excluded full-text studies, but both (a) a screening account with counts (Fig 1: 1293 identified, exclusions by category, 72 included) and (b) explicit inclusion criteria are reported

domains.domain: risk of bias assessment of included studies
domains.note: absent: no appraisal step in Materials and Methods (database → search terms → timespan → manual screening → inclusion criteria) or Results; no quality, bias, appraisal, critical appraisal or risk-of-bias wording anywhere; the Results remark on heterogeneity and subjectivity of studies describes no appraisal
absent: no quantitative synthesis, pooling model or heterogeneity statistic described in Materials and Methods or Results; findings are presented narratively
absent: no funnel plot, Egger test, small-study or publication-bias wording in Materials and Methods, Results or Discussion

sources.fact_fa: امتیاز DES این مقاله ۲۲ از ۱۰۰ است و در باند D (شواهد ضعیف) با نوع سؤال ETIOLOGY قرار می‌گیرد.
sources.interpretation_fa: این review جستجوی PubMed و فلوچارت غربالگری دارد، اما فقط یک دیتابیس دارد، protocol ثبت‌شده ندارد و کیفیت مطالعات را ارزیابی نکرده است. به گفته‌ی خود نویسندگان، مطالعات اولیه اغلب anecdotal و غیراستاندارد هستند. ارزشش در نقشه‌ی منظم علل food impaction و درمان متناظر هر علت است. بخش درمان (THERAPY) توصیفی است و اثربخشی روش‌ها را مقایسه نمی‌کند.
